title: Reported Speech 3 – Zeitenverschiebung
description: present → past, will → would, present perfect → past perfect

items.task: Ordne zu: direkte Rede → indirekte Rede.
items.prompt: Zeitformen
“I want a cake,” James said.
items.text: James said that he ___ a cake.

items.prompt: “Our dog is sleeping,” Mia said.
“I have lost my phone,” Ravi said.
items.text: Ravi said that he ___ his phone.

items.prompt: “We visited Rome,” the Smiths said.
items.text: The Smiths said that they ___ Rome.

items.prompt: “I will help you,” Anna told him.
items.text: Anna told him that she ___ help him.

items.prompt: “We can speak French,” the girls said.
items.text: The girls said that they ___ speak French.

items.prompt: “I must leave early,” Dad said.
items.text: Dad said that he ___ leave early.

items.prompt: “I had already eaten,” Tim said.
items.text: Tim said that he ___ already eaten.
items.hint: Das Past Perfect (had eaten) steht schon in der Vergangenheit – es bleibt in der indirekten Rede unverändert.

items.prompt: He said, “I like pizza.”
She said, “I am studying.”
They said, “We have finished.”
Ali said, “I will ring Sara tonight.”
items.text: Ali said that he ___ ring Sara that night.

items.prompt: Eva said, “I can play the piano.”
items.text: Eva said that she ___ play the piano.

items.prompt: Tom said, “I broke the window.”
items.text: Tom said that he ___ the window.

items.prompt: They said, “We are going to move.”
items.text: They said that they ___ to move.

items.prompt: She said, “I don’t know the answer.”
items.text: She said that she ___ the answer.

items.prompt: He said, “I have been waiting for an hour.”
items.text: He said that he ___ for an hour.

items.prompt: Mia said, “I must go home.”
items.text: Mia said that she ___ go home.

items.answer: He said that he was very tired.
She told us that they had already left.
Max said that he would phone us later.
They said that they could not come to the party.

items.prompt: “I live in Bristol,” Mark said.
answers: Mark said (that) he lived in Bristol.

items.prompt: “The kids are playing football,” Dad said.
answers: Dad said (that) the kids were playing football.

items.prompt: “I have finished my essay,” Lucy said.
answers: Lucy said (that) she had finished her essay.

items.prompt: “We watched a film last night,” they said.
answers: They said (that) they had watched a film the night before.
They said (that) they had watched a film the previous night.

items.prompt: “I will bake a cake,” Grandma said.
answers: Grandma said (that) she would bake a cake.

items.prompt: “Ruby can ride a horse,” her mum said.
answers: Her mum said (that) Ruby could ride a horse.

items.prompt: “I have been working all day,” Paul said.
answers: Paul said (that) he had been working all day.

items.prompt: “We are going to buy a new car,” my parents said.
answers: My parents said (that) they were going to buy a new car.
